mac-compiled.protocol: One Node process per variant/case/pair. Alternate order by pair. Parsing and reference execution precede timing. Fresh samples use separate interpreters and a shared parsed program. Prepared samples reuse one interpreter. RSS includes reference, warmups and diagnostics. GC mode collects before each sample and after diagnostics.
